question.problem:
Consider the picture shown below. Find the exact value of $|\mathbf{a}|.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14251078/assets/140b4f8ced622eaf505d97c0f4d9c029365536927ea0c3e38e76904cba84ace2.png)
question.worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14251078/assets/1fc7b5efcaa81dd1a3416757c976e5d17b96f5040069b5eeeb941b1f7c149c34.png)

In $\bigtriangleup AHB$ we have $\angle AHB = 90^\circ$, $AH=35\:\textrm{mm}$ and $BH=25\:\textrm{mm}.$ So, the Pythagorean theorem gives

$$
\begin{aligned}AB & =\sqrt{A{H}^{2}+B{H}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{{35}^{2}+{25}^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{1\,850} \\  & =5\sqrt{74}\,\text{mm}.\end{aligned}
$$
